gloss: to tighten; to become firm; to be taut

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {締|し}まっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to tighten; to become taut; to be firm
definitions.explanation: For something to become tight or taut physically. Used for knots, screws, muscles, body, etc.

definitions.gloss: to be disciplined; to become focused; to shape up
definitions.explanation: For an atmosphere, attitude, or person to become more serious, disciplined, or well-organized. Often used for situations where slack or looseness is corrected.

examples.japanese: ネジ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{締|し}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦ネクタイ→ネクタイ：01040_nekutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{締|し}まりすぎて⟦{苦|くる}しい→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧。
examples.english: The necktie is too tight and uncomfortable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{筋|きん}トレ→筋トレ：04915_kintore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{締|し}まってきた。
examples.english: My body has become toned from weight training.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{締|し}めろ→引き締める：15264_hikishimeru⟧。
examples.english: Get your act together. / Focus up.

examples.japanese: {試合前|しあいまえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{締|し}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The players' expressions are focused before the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{締|し}まった。
examples.english: The coach's one remark instantly tightened up the atmosphere of the practice.

notes: Distinguished from the homophone ⟦{閉|し}まる→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧ (to close/shut). {締|し}まる is about tightness and tension, while ⟦{閉|し}まる→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧ is about closing. Godan verb; transitive counterpart is ⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ (to tighten/fasten). Common collocations: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{締|し}まる (body becomes toned), ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|ひ}き{締|し}まる (spirits tighten up, become focused), ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{締|し}まる (purse strings tighten, become frugal). The negative form ⟦{締|し}まりがない→締まりがない：17321_shimariganai⟧ means 'slack' or 'undisciplined.'
